lines.text: Does it have a swimming pool?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: It does have a swimming pool. And they have plenty of room. So if you want to come with a big group, that's definitely a better option.

lines.speaker: Michael
lines.text: That sounds like a great idea. I can invite my colleagues along . So do you have any final tips for me, for my holiday in Portugal?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Well, I mean, if you want to stay in the South, in the Algarve, then I definitely recommend you check out the nightlife. I can be really lively in there in night markets where you can buy lots of souvenirs and people just hang around. So I definitely recommend that.

lines.speaker: Michael
lines.text: Okay, and what was the name again? The Algarve?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: The Algarve, yeah. That's the southern part of Portugal, so you can't miss it .

lines.speaker: Michael
lines.text: Oh, I got to remember that. Thank you very much.

lines.speaker: Michael
lines.text: So Ana, you're from Portugal. Can you tell me a little bit about your country?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Yes, sure. Portugal is a really small country actually. It's right by Spain in Europe and we have really nice weather there. It's really sunny most of the year and really hot in summer. It can get really cold and really rainy in winter. But yeah, overall, it's a really nice country to live in.

lines.speaker: Michael
lines.text: And I've heard you have nice beaches in Portugal.

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Yes, we do. I used to go to the beach everyday with my family in summer. It was really great. But the beaches can get really crowded. Lots of people, so you might want to be a bit careful when you choose where to go.

lines.speaker: Michael
lines.text: All right, I see. And where do you live in Portugal?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: I live in a small village actually. You probably don't know it. It's called Palmela. But it's south of Lisbon and it's by the coast, so it's really nice. We get a nice view of the mountains and of the rivers. So I really enjoy living there. It's really quite. Not a lot of people. A lot of wine farms actually and really nice food. You should come and visit sometime.

lines.speaker: Michael
lines.text: I like wine. And so you have good wine in Portugal. What sort of food do you eat in Portugal?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Let's see. We get a lot of fish because we're by the sea. And so codfish is a traditional and sardines and mackerels .

lines.speaker: Michael
lines.text: Oh, I like sardines.

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Yeah. It's really good. And we also have really good desserts. So for example, coffee cake, yogurt cake. We've got pastel de nata which is kind of an egg tart thing. So I really recommend you try that with our coffee when you go there.

lines.speaker: Michael
lines.text: All right. And you speak Portuguese as your first language.

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Yes, I do. I speak Portuguese. It's not the same as Brazilian Portuguese but it's really close and we can understand each other. So that's really great.

lines.speaker: Michael
lines.text: All right. And can you understand Spanish as well?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Yeah. I can understand a little bit of Spanish but there are some differences between Portuguese and Spanish.

lines.speaker: Michael
lines.text: How do you say hello in Portuguese?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Oh, you can say, "Ola."

lines.speaker: Michael
lines.text: Ola.

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Yeah, it's fun. You should learn some Portuguese.

lines.speaker: Michael
lines.text: Oh, I'd love to.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: So we're talking about holidays. Is there any really, really good holidays that you remember?

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: Well, one of my favourite holidays was when I went to Greece a couple of years ago with my family.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Wow, Greece, I've never been there. How is it? Sounds really, really nice.

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: Greece is a very beautiful country. The houses are ... everything is so white and the beaches are so beautiful.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: So what did you do in Greece?

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: Mainly I just relaxed at the swimming pool and at the beaches. And at night time I went shopping with my mum. And we had some really nice food too.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Oh, that sounds really interesting, like the perfect holidays. So you said you went with your family, right?

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: Yes, I went with my mum and dad and brother.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: And for how long did you go there?

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: We went for four days. And when we went there was a big football tournament. And so everybody was so happy and excited. And at night times everybody will start dancing. And so me and my brother, we would join and dance with them.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Cool! So did you get to see any of those matches of the tournament?

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: Yes, I went to see one match with my dad and I had so much fun.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Oh, it sounds really cool, like really nice holidays.

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: Yes, it was one of my best holidays.

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: So Daniel, I heard you went on a vacation, where did you go?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Yeah, I went to Taiwan.

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: Oh, sounds interesting. What did you do?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Well, I did a lot of things. It's a really interesting place. I saw a lot of culture. I saw a lot of history. I went to beautiful places. They have like really, really beautiful nature. Everything was really, really good.

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: How was the food?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Well, the food in Taiwan is amazing. You wouldn't believe how good it is. Everything tastes amazing. And the good thing about it , it's really, really cheap.

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: I see. Who did you go with?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: I went with a Taiwanese friend, so that was really good because I cannot speak Mandarin. And my friend helped me a lot with all the food, and that was really good because I really appreciated that.

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: How long did you go for?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: It was about eight days. And I think it was more than enough to get like a quick view of the whole island. It was really nice to go from Taipei in the north to some cities in the south. I think I got a really good impression of what Taiwan is.

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: Why did you go to Taiwan?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Well I'm really interested in Asia and Asian cultures, and since it's really far from my background, I really want to get to know better all those cultures. And since for many western people are quite the same, I really want to find out those differences. And that's why I chose Taiwan.

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: I see.

lessons.title: What are you going to do tonight?

lines.text: Hi, my name is Billy and I am living in South Africa. So today I'm going to talk about what I'm going to do tonight.

Right now it's about 13 minutes to 9:00 PM in South Africa. So let's say 8:47-48 right now. And I'm planning to have dinner . I have not had dinner yet. I'm looking forward to having dinner and probably finish a Korean movie . So I'm not sure if you're anything like me, but I love watching Korean movies. I love watching movies in general. So there's this series I haven't finished watching, and I would love to do that tonight. Kick my feet up, put my feet up , and just watch a Korean movie. Hopefully I will be able to at least watch one episode and then go to bed. So, chill night, nothing much. I think the morning was busy, the day was busy, so I really look forward to just chilling , relaxing , and watching my movie.
Thank you. Bye.
Hey guys. In this video I'm going to talk about my two homes and how they're very different.

So I live about half the year in Japan and half the year in Thailand . And my life is different in each place. So in Thailand, I don't cook much. Actually, I don't cook at all because my little apartment does not have a kitchen , so I eat out often. Actually, I eat out all the time in Japan, though. I cook some In Japan. I don't use the bus that much. I have a car, so I drive a lot. But in Thailand, I don't drive at all . I never drive actually. So I either take the bus or I take the BTS . So that's a little bit different. Also in Japan, I don't walk much, don't walk around that much. But in Thailand, I walk around a lot. I walk to the park, I walk down the street. I'm just always walking. So I kind of like that.

In Japan, I speak Japanese , but I don't speak that much. Actually. I don't know why. I guess because people don't talk as much in Japan, and maybe my Japanese is not as good. But in Thailand, I speak Thai a lot, so maybe that's also a little bit different. In Thailand, I don't spend that much money, but Bangkok is getting more expensive. And then where I live in Japan's not too expensive, so I don't spend that much money there, but I spend much more money on rent in Japan than I do in Thailand. So both places are great. I love 'em, but they're just a little bit different.
Hello. My name is Hazal and I'm from Turkey. My question is, do you have any pets ?

Yes, I have a pet. I have a cat . My cat's name is Lily. Lily is four years old. She is small and very soft . Lily sleeps in the mornings and plays with her toys in the evenings. Her favorite toy is a ball . I give Lily food every morning. She eats and drinks water every day. I love my cat. She makes me very happy . I also love dogs. I want a dog , but I do not have a dog yet.
How about you?
Do you have any pets?
Hi, I am Lisa. I am from Ukraine. My question is, what time is it now?
Now I am in Ukraine and it is 11:30 AM but I usually live in Poland and in Poland now it is 10:30 AM.
Hi, my name is Lisa. I am from Ukraine. My question is, how old is your shirt ?

I have two shirts. This shirt is not very new. Maybe from last year. This shirt is 1-year-old. This is a jacket . This jacket is new. This jacket is from two months ago. I change my style a lot. I change my style often, and I buy a lot of new clothes . But if material is good, if the shirt looks good, I wear it for a long time .

lessons.title: Do you like indoor pets, like birds or fish?

lines.text: Hello. My name's Risa and I'm from the Philippines . My question is, do you like indoor pets, like birds or fish?

Well, yes I do. I like indoor pets like birds or fish . They are easy to take care of. I have a hedgehog . My hedgehog lives in a big cage with food and water. I clean its cage every week. Hedgehogs don't need to take a bath every day, so I only clean it once or twice a month. I like taking pictures of it. Sometimes I let it run around the living room . I love my indoor pet because it's so cute.

lessons.title: What do you do on the weekend?

lines.text: Hello, my name is Nerry and I am from Belize . My question today is, what do you do on the weekend?

On the weekend, I like to rest and clean my house. I sweep the floor and mop the floor, and I do laundry . I also do self-care, such as getting my nails done , getting my hair done , or getting my eyelashes done . The weekends is usually laidback and slow for me. I rest and prepare myself for the new week. I prepare myself by meditating , reflecting on journaling in my book.
My question to you is what do you do on the weekend?

lessons.title: Do you buy your dinner at the supermarket?

lines.text: Hello, my name is Rocio and I am from El Salvador . My question is, do you buy dinner at the supermarket ?

Do I buy dinner at the supermarket? Sometimes whenever I'm busy, I buy dinner. At the supermarket, they have pre-made foods that are very easy to heat up . I like to buy sushi or rice with vegetables , but I don't like to buy fast food because it's not very healthy. I also don't like frozen meals because they don't taste really fresh. So I buy vegetables and chicken and cook at home. The supermarket is very convenient for me whenever I am busy because it has many options for pre-made food. But I prefer to cook if there is time.
And do you buy dinner at the supermarket?

lessons.title: What are your plans for tonight?

lines.text: Hi. In this video I'm going to talk a little bit about my plans for tonight. So right now I am at a park.

You can kind of see the park here, and I'm going to go running. I'm going to run for about 40 minutes and I am going to get some exercise I really need to run. I try to run one hour every day, and then after I run, I'm going to take some photos of the park because I love this park and I'm going to share them with my friends. I'm going to post on Facebook, and then after that I am going to drive home, and then I'm going to have dinner with my family . I think tonight we're going to have pizza, although I'm not sure. And then after dinner, I think I'm going to relax and chat with my mom and my dad, and then I'm going to go to bed early. I'm not going to stay up late because tomorrow I have to get up early because I'm going to drive to another city and I'm going to meet my niece and nephew because my nephew is getting married . So I'm going to be doing a lot of things, so I'm going to be very busy.
Hi, my name is Billy and I live in South Africa. Today I'm going to talk about whether I cook a lot. Do I cook often or much?

Yes, I have a big family and I enjoy cooking, so I love making different cuisines , different foods from different places. I love my Asian foods . I love making miso soup . That's Japanese and I love eating buns, pork buns , that's Chinese. I also enjoy my spaghetti , my rice , pasta, everything. I love food in general, so I do enjoy cooking and I do try to cook much despite my busy schedule .
So yeah, I hope to have more time to cook, but for now I enjoy the time. I do have. Bye.
Hello, my name is Elizabeth and I am from America. My question is, is your town nice ?

Yes, my town is nice. It is a small town. It is not big. It is not busy . It has five really nice coffee shops . It has a university . There are nice parks here. It does not have a lot of shops for shopping , but it is near a bigger town. I have lived in this town for three years. I do not want to move . I am happy here.
My question for you is, is your town nice?

lessons.title: What cold drinks do you like in summer?

lines.text: Hello, my name is Hazal and I'm from Turkiye. My question is, what cold drinks do you like in the summer ?

I enjoy cold drinks because they are very refreshing and very nice. One of my favorite cold drinks is water with ice , because it is very simple and very healthy. I also like to drink orange juice because orange juice is also healthy and it is very sweet. Sometimes I drink iced tea , but I like my iced tea with lemon because lemon makes it taste better. I like to drink milkshake too, but my favorite milkshake is strawberry milkshake because I love strawberries.
How about you? What cold drinks do you like to drink?
Hi everyone. This is your teacher, Todd and I will talk about my day.

So today I had a really good day. I woke up early and I read for a bit. I read a book that I love. It's got a really, really good story. And then I took a drive . I drove down here to the countryside and I walked along the rice fields here and I just relaxed.

Then I went to the beach and I sat on the beach and just did nothing. I did nothing. I just sat there and I looked out at the ocean and just cleared my mind . It was a really nice day. So it was a really fun Sunday. I felt relaxed all day and I didn't feel stressed, and now I'm ready for work tomorrow. So, yeah, it was a good day.
I didn't buy anything. Oh wait, I did. I bought lunch, but besides that, I didn't buy anything.

lessons.title: Do you use the train or the bus?

lines.text: Hello, my name is Lisa. I am from Ukraine . My question is, do you use the train or bus ?

I use the bus in my city . If I go to the supermarket , I use the bus, but I don't like the bus. If I travel , if I go to another city, if I travel to another country , I don't like the bus. I like the train. I travel by train to other country or other city.
Do you like the train or the bus?
Hi, my name is Nerissa and I'm from the Philippines. My question is, what drinks do you dislike?

I dislike coconut juice and beer. Coconut juice tastes weird to me, and I can't eat or drink anything with coconut. I also don't like beer because it's too bitter for me. I don't enjoy it. Maybe because I don't drink alcohol often. When I have to drink beer with my family members and friends, I make sure that the beer is very cold, and then I drink soda afterward to wash off the taste.
What about you? What drinks do you dislike?
Hello, my name is Nerry, and I am from Belize. My question today is, what food is not healthy?

Fried chicken wings is not healthy. To make it healthy, I prepare it in the air-fryer. Fried chicken wings is not healthy because it is greasy and it is made by frying the wings in oil. The air fryer fries the wings without oil making it very delicious and healthy.
My question for you today is what?
Food is not healthy?

lessons.title: Are clothing shops cheap in your town?

lines.text: Hello there. My name is Rocio and I'm from El Salvador. My question is, are clothing shops cheap in your town? Are clothing shops cheap in my town?

In my town, there are a lot of different options when you buy clothes, but local thrift shops are the most common. They are very cheap and they have a lot of clothes, but the quality may not always be the best. For better quality, you can go to big stores at the mall, but they can be really expensive. Sometimes shops have sales and prices are lower, but it really depends on where you are looking and on the season.
So I'd say that clothes are fairly cheap in El Salvador, but it really depends on the store and on where you are looking.
And you are clothing shops in your town cheap?
Hi everybody, this is Todd, and now I am in Taiwan. Actually, I'm in the city Tai Chung. And Tai Chiang is near Taipei.

It is a big city. It is a modern city, and it is a very nice city. It is near Taipei. It is about one hour away by train, and the city has many nice things. The streets are clean, the people are nice, the food is delicious. Now it is summer, so the weather is warm, although today is a wet day because there is some rain, but that's okay.

Actually, there is a typhoon nearby, but the typhoon is not in this city. This typhoon is not coming to this city, but it is coming very close. I am here for a conference, and the conference is at a university. It is tomorrow. It is on Saturday, so I'm excited about that. And now I'm just enjoying this great city.
As you can see, it is busy, it is lively. It's a lot of fun here, and I really like it.
How about your city? Is your city fun? Is your city clean? Is it big? Is it modern? Is it warm? Is it expensive?
Most of all, I hope your city is a nice place to live.

lessons.title: What foods do you like together?

lines.text: Hello, my name is Elizabeth. I'm from America, and my question is, what foods do you like together?

I like many, many foods together. I like peanut butter and jelly. I like banana and peanut butter. I love oatmeal and blueberries. I like avocado and toast. I like salmon and vegetables. I like beans and rice. I love peaches and cream together. I love sweet and salty foods together. For example, I like chocolate and nuts. I do not like beans and cheese together. I do not like oranges and chocolate together.
My question for you is, what foods do you like together?

lessons.title: What is different about the city and countryside?

lines.text: Hi, I am Elise, and I'm going to talk about the difference between living in the city and living in the countryside.

So in the countryside, the cities and villages are smaller than big cities, which means they're calmer. There's less traffic and less pollution. So they are usually considered healthier to live in than living in the big city. But some people do find it less interesting or a bit more boring to live in the countryside because the cities offer more entertainment options. Large cities also offer more options in terms of education and employment, but the crime levels are higher, too. So it's really a personal choice.
Which one do you think is better: living in a city or in the countryside?

lessons.title: What do you eat for breakfast?

lines.text: Hello, my name is Hazal, and I am from Turkey. My question is, what do you eat for breakfast?

Generally, I eat bread, eggs, and cheese for breakfast because bread keeps me full. Egg is easy to make and also keeps me full, and cheese is very delicious. Sometimes I eat oatmeal with fruit because it is sweet, and I like to eat fruit for my breakfast because it gives me energy, and it's very delicious.
I like to drink coffee with my breakfast because coffee helps me wake up. And I also love coffee. I love to eat breakfast because breakfast gives me energy for the day, and it is very delicious.

lessons.title: What did you do last night?

lines.text: Hi everyone. My name is Jill, and I'm from Australia. And my question today is, what did you do last night?

I had a really fun night last night. I got to meet with some friends that I hadn't seen in a while, so my friend cooked dinner for us, so we went to her place and we sat together, we ate all of the food, and we talked. We laughed and we danced a little all through the night. She made a beautiful dish with mushroom rice and chicken and potatoes, and afterwards we helped clean, so we vacuumed her living room. We cleaned the dishes, and then we decided that we wanted some dessert. And so we walked to the nearest bubble tea shop where we laughed so much that we were scared we were going to get kicked out, but we didn't. And so we sat, we laughed, we talked, and then I had to say goodnight and come home for the evening.
What about you? What did you do last night? Did you do anything fun?

lessons.title: What sport uses gloves? What happens?

lines.text: Hello, my name is Lisa. I am from Ukraine. My question is, what sport uses gloves? What happens?

A lot of sports use gloves, for example, boxing. Boxers hit each other. Gloves help them. They do not hurt their hands. Also, baseball uses gloves, but only one glove. Players catch the ball. Hockey uses gloves. Players hold the stick. They do not hurt their hands. Gloves help in these sports.
Do you play a sport with gloves?

lessons.title: What will you do in the near future?

lines.text: My brother will turn 18 years old this month. I will buy him a gift for his birthday, but I won't be here. I'll be in Spain on holiday. I won't forget to call him from Spain to wish him happy birthday. What will I buy him for his birthday present?

Perhaps I will buy him a gift in Spain. Maybe I will buy him some spices, although I won't be able to take spices on the airplane. I am a little sad that I won't be here for his birthday, but he won't care. He'll be too busy partying with his friends. I will be here for his next birthday, though. Next year I'll take him to a really nice restaurant so he won't be mad at me for not being here this year. What will you do for your birthday?

lessons.title: What are you doing at the moment?

lines.text: Hey guys, what's up? This is Todd from ELLLO, and in this video we're going to look at the present continuous.

So now I am standing in a farm field, and I am holding the camera, and I am taking a video of this. I'm hoping that this video comes out nice, and it's very clear today. It's a great day. The sun is shining and it's not raining, and the wind is blowing a little bit, but that's okay. It's kind of nice. It's nice and breezy. And basically today, I am having a good time. I am enjoying myself and I'm looking forward to seeing my family later tonight. So yeah, that's what I'm doing right now.
How about you?
I hope so.
Hello there. My name is Rocio, and I'm from El Salvador. My question is, what is near your house? What is near my house?

Near my house, there is a park where people walk and play. I walk my dog there in the afternoons. There is also a supermarket about five minutes away. And it's great because I don't have to travel too far for groceries. There aren't any big malls or cinemas nearby, but there is a bakery that smells amazing. There aren't many noisy places, so it's very peaceful, and I like living here because everything that I need is very close.
And what about you? What is near your home?
Hi, my name is Nerry, and I'm from Belize. My question is, what is your job?

My job is a personal trainer. This means I get to help people to lose weight, to get more slim. I get to help people to live a better quality of life because you have a better life when you are more stronger, when you're able to do more things, when you're able to walk further and when you're able to lift things. It's also good when you exercise, when you have a personal trainer because your bones get stronger and your muscles get stronger. I also get to help people, to build confidence, to love themselves more.
I really love my job. I love my job so much that I stop my other job to focus on this job. This job is my passion because I love this job.

lessons.title: Is your house near a park?

lines.text: Hi, my name's Nerissa, and I'm from the Philippines. My question is, is your house near a park?

Well, yes it is. My house is near a park. It's only a 15 to 20 minute walk or even less if you walk fast. The park isn't very big, but it's not too small either. I love going there because it has a water fountain and a basketball court. There also food stalls around, so I can grab something to eat while relaxing on a bench. I usually visit the park on weekend afternoons.

lessons.title: What time do you wake up every day?

lines.text: Hi, I am Lisa. I am from Ukraine. My question is, what time do you wake up every day?

lines.speaker: Usually I wake up at 8
lines.text: 00 AM, maybe 8:30 AM. I don't like to wake up early. I don't wake up at 6:00 AM, at 7:00 AM. No, no. At the weekend, I like to sleep more. I like to sleep longer. Sometimes I wake up at 10 at the weekend or I wake up at 9:30.
What time do you wake up?
Hi everyone. My name is Jill and I'm from Australia. And my question today is, where do you live?

Normally, if you ask me that question, like I said, I'm from Australia and I live in Sydney. I live in a suburb called Lipcome, which is actually where a lot of Korean people live, which is where my family is from. So there are lots of shops and restaurants that are Korean, sell Korean products. And yeah, a lot of the faces in the neighborhood are Korean. But actually what's interesting is if you ask me that question now, I would say I do not live in Sydney, and I live in Seoul in South Korea.

This year I am living with my grandparents who are in South Korea, and so I'm living in a neighborhood called Haebangchon, which is very, very different in the sense that there is a big mountain at my grandparents' neighborhood sits underneath. And so when I look out the window, I can see a big mountain with lots of trees and with Soul Tower sitting at the top. It's a very different environment, although walking around people are still Korean.
What about you? Where do you live?

lessons.title: When do you drink your favorite drink?

lines.text: Hello, my name is Elizabeth. I'm from America, and my question is, when do you drink your favorite drink?

I drink my favorite drink in the morning. I love hot tea. I like honey with my tea. I like to drink tea in the morning. It is quiet. I like to read a book. I also like to drink tea at a coffee shop. It is really nice. I do not like tea without honey. I like sweet tea. I also like to drink tea in the evening. I love to watch a movie and drink tea. I also like hot chocolate, but I love hot tea.
My question for you is when do you drink your favorite drink?

lessons.title: What is the geography of your country?

lines.text: Hi, my name is Elise, and I'm going to talk about the geography of the Netherlands.

In the Netherlands, there are no mountains, but there are some low hills in the south. There's a long coastline, and there are also some islands off the north coast and off the south coast in the west. There are several forests and there are also some provinces with lakes. There are no volcanoes and there aren't any rainforests, either. The climate is temperate, and it's also very humid, so this means that it can rain any day, in any season, any time of the year. So that means if you go out cycling, you must bring a raincoat anytime you go out cycling.
Are there any distinct geographical features in your region?

lessons.title: Do you watch sports on TV?

lines.text: Hello, my name is Hazal and I'm from Turkiye. My question is, do you watch sports on TV?

Yes, I watch sports on TV. I like to watch tennis the most because I like how the players hit the ball and move quickly. Another sports I like to watch is volleyball because I like teamwork, and the rules of volleyball is very interesting. One sports that I don't like to watch is football because I find it boring, but my father loves it, so sometimes I watch it. I think watching sports on TV is a great activity to do with family and friends because it is a great way to enjoy and relax.
Hello, my name is Hazal and I'm from Turkey. My question is, what snacks are healthy?

Fruits are a good choice for healthy snacks. You can eat apples, bananas, or grapes for healthy choices. Another choice is vegetables. If you want to eat a salty snack, you can choose carrots or cucumbers. Another good choice is nuts, like walnuts or peanuts, but you should not eat them too much. You can also eat yogurt because it is also another good choice for a healthy snack. You can mix yogurt with some good fruits to make it even more tasty. You can also eat dark chocolate for a healthy choice, but it should not be too much.

lessons.title: When do you start and finish your day?

lines.text: Hi, my name's Nerrisa, and I'm from the Philippines. My question is, when do you start and finish your day?

My day starts at seven o'clock in the morning. I work from home, so I don't need to rush in the morning. My work starts at eight o'clock, so I have an hour to prepare. I wash my face, I make coffee, and then I check my schedule on the computer. During my free time, I do my hobbies, like coloring and playing online games. I also cook and clean my home. In the afternoon, I take a nap and a shower before working again at 5:00 PM. I finish work at 9:00 PM, and then I do my routine afterwards, my night routine. My day usually finishes at around 11 in the evening.
What about you? When do you start and finish your day?

lessons.title: What is your favorite TV show?

lines.text: Hello, my name is Nerry, and I am from Belize. My question today is, what is your favorite TV show?

My favorite TV show is called Dexter. It is a show about a man named Dexter. Dexter is a police detective who kills bad people. Not everyone likes Dexter because the show involves a lot of blood. I enjoy watching crime shows and detective shows. That is why I love Dexter.
My question to you is, what is your favorite TV show?

lessons.title: What do you do in the morning?

lines.text: Hello, my name is Rocio, and I am from El Salvador. My question is, what do you do in the morning?

In the morning, I wake up at 6:00 AM. I brush my teeth, and I wash my face. I then eat breakfast. I like to eat eggs with toasts and avocado. I don't drink coffee, so I drink water or orange juice. After breakfast, I get ready to start work at 7:00 AM. Since I work from home, I don't take the bus or drive my car. During the morning. I also take a break, so sometimes I go for a walk with my dog around the park.
And you, what do you do in the morning?

lessons.title: What can you do in the park?

lines.text: Hi everybody. Hi, this is Todd, your teacher from ELLLO, and today I'm in a park in Seoul, Korea, and it is a beautiful, beautiful park, and you can do many things in this park.

You can take lovely pictures of the city. You can actually see the entire city because it's on a hill, so you have a great view. You can see things here that you cannot see down on the street, and you can relax. It's quiet. You can read a book, you can stretch out on the grass, but it's kind of a nature park. So you can't play sports, you can't do exercise. But Korea has some great parks near the river, and the parks near the river are perfect for sports. You can run, you can ride a bike, you can play sports, you can do exercise, you can even lift weights. They have little weight machines down there and you can exercise. They have these all over Korea, actually. So you can definitely get exercise in Korea and you don't have to go to a gym. So the parks in Korea are fantastic, some of the best in the world. You can do so many things in these parks, and that's one of the reasons I really, really love coming to Korea.

My job is to teach English. I am an English teacher. I teach English to my students. I teach how to read, write, and speak English. Sometimes we do activities in the class. We watch English movies. We play English games, and we listen to English music. I love my students, and my students love me. I like my school. I teach English because I like to help people. I love my job.
What is your job?

It's actually getting darker this time of year because it's fall, so the weather is getting cooler and the temperature is dropping. But I kind of like that, actually. It's just a really nice time of year, you know. I like the fall because it's just prettier. I think the weather is nicer, the scenery is more beautiful, and it's cooler. It's not so hot. So I really, really like the fall, so I'm having a good day today, enjoying myself at the beach.

I hope so. I'm happier right now because the weather is cooler, and it's not so hot.

lessons.title: What are you doing right now?

So right now I am working from my computer. I am working in my home office. There's a lot of natural light here. I have plants around the room, so some greenery. I can see my dog sleeping right now. I just walked him about two miles, so he is tired. I am also drinking a cup of my favorite tea. It's a blackberry tea. I added some milk to it, so it's really nice. So whenever I'm working from home, I always like to brew myself a cup of tea. It just makes my day go a little bit better.
So after this, I will probably plan to go for another walk, but right now I'm going to finish up work for the day and that is what I'm doing right now.

lessons.title: What are some festivals in your area?

lines.text: Hi, I'm Elise, and I'm going to talk about the weather and festivities in Peru.

In January, it's summer and lots of people go to the beach at the coast. Children are on summer holiday. In February, they celebrate carnival by throwing lots of water balloons at each other. In March, children go back to school. In April, they celebrate Easter with some really delicious special breads. In May, lots of tourists start coming to Peru, and it's quite cold because it's almost winter.

In June, there are a lot of religious festivities. One of the most important ones is called in Inti Raymi, and this happens in Cusco. In July, they celebrate Independence Day at the end of the month. In August, children have two weeks of holiday again. In September, there aren't many festivities, and winter is almost over.

In October, there's a very important religious festival called Lord of the Miracles. It's biggest in Lima. In November, it starts heating up a little bit, and the rainy season sometimes starts in the mountains and in the jungle, too. In December, it's definitely the rainy season and children start looking forward to their summer holiday.
Hi, my name's Nerissa, and I'm from the Philippines. My question is, where does your family live?

My family lives in Cavite. It is an hour away from Manila. The capital city of the Philippines. Cavite is a small province . Before there were many fields and farms . Now there are buildings and malls . More people live and visit here. My family likes it because we can go to different places. There is a famous tourist park in Cavita. It is known for its cool weather and nice view of a volcano . We go there when there's a special occasion , like birthdays or holidays .
What about you? Where does your family live?
Hello, my name is Rocio and I am from El Salvador. My question is, what fruits do you like? What fruits do I like?

I like bananas . I like mangoes . I like watermelon . I like pineapples , but I love grapes. I love them when they are really sweet . I don't like sour fruits, like lemons or grapefruits when they are green, like a green apple or green grapes . In El Salvador, we have many tropical fruits.
And you, what fruits do you like? What fruits are common in your country?
Hi, everybody, this is Todd, your teacher from ELLLO. And right now I am at my favorite place and this is a beach near my house where I live and teach and work in Japan.

And I love this beach for many reasons. One, there aren't many people on the beach, so usually this beach is really quiet and there's not a lot going on. There's many trees near the beach. There's a beautiful forest , so you can kind of take a walk in there. And the beach usually is really clean. There isn't much pollution , there isn't much noise , although sometimes you can hear a plane because many planes land by the airport . I guess we can't see one now, but there are many planes in this area, and it's just a nice place. There's a lot of space , there's a lot of light, and it's just a really peaceful place. And so because of that, I really enjoy it. And there's many things you can do here. You can take a walk, you can relax on the beach, you can listen to the waves . It's just really, really peaceful. So for that reason, I love this beach. It's my favorite place in.

lessons.title: Who will you see tonight or tomorrow?

So I have a dog and they have a little poodle , and that is who I'm going to see tonight and tomorrow.

On Tuesday morning, I go to yoga class. It's very relaxing . On Tuesday afternoon, I teach English from two till 10:00 PM On Wednesday morning, I clean the house. It's a bit boring , but very important. In the afternoon, I take my children to the park. On Thursday morning, I have a Spanish class. We have a new teacher right now, his name is Mr. Sanchez. On Thursday evening, we often play board games with my family. On Friday morning, I teach English again, and on Friday afternoon I go to the park or I visit my mother. On Saturday, I often meet with a friend, usually in the afternoon to drink coffee. Sometimes on Saturday night I go to see a play and on Sunday we go to the park or we go to the gym .
What's your favorite day of the week?

lessons.title: What did you do over the weekend?

lines.text: Hi everyone, I'm Jill and I'm from Australia. And my question today is what did you do over the weekend?

So last weekend I actually had a very special weekend. I took my mom on a trip to Tedra Island. We took a boat down to Tedra Island and we spent the whole weekend going on lots of big walks and eating lots of really good seafood . We ate lots of abalone and lots of sashimi , which was super fresh and delicious. And we went on lots of hikes . They have a beautiful mountain in the center of the island and all around it is big forest . And so we hiked through the forest and we saw lots of beautiful colors that are happening right now because it is autumn.

In Korea, we also went to a massage shop where we were able to sleep a little and have massages, and we drank lots and lots of good coffee, which was surprising because I wasn't expecting that we had really good weather , which was very lucky because it can be a little bit cold. But yeah, I had a really lovely weekend.
And what about you? What did you do over the weekend?
