lines.text: Ah, got it. I’ll try to check it out then.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I missed class yesterday. What did you do in class?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Not much. The teacher just reviewed past lessons.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Oh yeah. What did she go over?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: She mainly talked about the essay assignment and how to write the paper.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Did she give any homework?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yes, but she posted it on the class website.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: OK, I’ll check it out then. Thanks.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: What did you do last night?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I just stayed home and talked with my friends on Zoom.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Friends from work?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: No, friends I studied with in college.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Oh, that’s so cool that you are still friends.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Well, we kind of lost touch with each other, but we recently reunited on Facebook.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I should do that with my old army buddies.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: You should. It’s a lot of fun. We all enjoyed seeing each other again.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: What did you do last night?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I just stayed home and took it easy. And you?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I went to the park and played football.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Oh, did you win ?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Yeah, we won ! I was so happy.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Oh, I am glad you had a good time.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I hurt my ankle though, so it wasn’t all perfect.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Well, at least you won !

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: How was your trip to Brazil?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: It was wonderful. I had such a great time.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: How was the food?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: It was all so good. I ate so much. I think I put on some weight.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: What did you do there?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Well, we spent a lot of time at the beach, but we also went out at night.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I hear the nightlife there is really good.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: It is! We had so much fun!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: What did you do over the weekend?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I met some friends for dinner.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Oh, where did you go ?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: We ate at the new pizza place near the station.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Oh, I went there last week. I really liked it.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: So did we. What did you eat ?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: We tried the pan-style pizza. It was so good

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I didn’t try that, but I heard it was really good.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Yeah, my friend told me to try it. He said it was good and he was right.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I’ll try it next time.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: What did you do over the holidays?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Not much. I bought a new car, though.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Really, what did you buy ?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I bought a new Lexus. It is so nice.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Can I ask? How much did you pay for it?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: It cost about 50,000 dollars. I took out a loan though.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Wow, you paid a lot! I think I spent about 5,000 pounds for my car, but I bought it used.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yeah, I really wanted a new car. I think I got what I paid for though.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: How is your new job?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: It’s good . The job is interesting , and the people are nice .

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Is it near your house?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: No, it is in the city, so it’s far away . It takes an hour to get there.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Oh, no! How is the commute?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: It’s long , and it is expensive , but I don’t mind too much.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Why don’t you take the bus? It’s really cheap .

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I would, but the bus is really slow and crowded ! I can’t get a seat.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Yeah, it is crowded .

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: How was your weekend?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Good. I went to the new mall.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Oh yeah? How was it?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Great ! It has a really nice food court.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Oh, cool ! How was the food?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Really good . The food was delicious and not expensive .

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Was it healthy ?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Not really, but the portions are really big .

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Oh, that's good to know!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: How is your new computer?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Good . It is fast and has lots of cool features.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: It looks expensive , though.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yeah, it’s not cheap , but I need it for work.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Is it light ? It doesn’t look very heavy .

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yes, it is very light . It only weighs one kilogram.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Wow, that is light ! My computer is so big and heavy .

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Is your computer old ?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Yes, it's over five years old. It's time for a new one!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yeah, that is pretty old for a computer.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: How is your math class?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Not good . It is very difficult .

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Oh, I thought you liked math.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I do, but the class is hard , and the teacher is really boring .

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Oh, that’s too bad .

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Plus, the room is really old, and the chairs are uncomfortable .

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: That doesn’t sound like a fun class!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: It's not!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I see you got a new phone.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yeah, I just got it yesterday.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: How is it?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Great. It is better than my last phone. It is also lighter .

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: How's the camera? Does it take better pictures?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yes. The pictures are great. The images are brighter and sharper . Much prettier than before.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Sounds great. I should get a new phone as well.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Well, if you do buy it online, it's cheaper .

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Good advice. I think I'll do that.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: How is your online class going?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Good. It's better than I expected.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Oh, I'm happy to hear that.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yeah, it's more convenient to study at home and it is also more relaxing .

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: How so?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Well, I don't have to get dressed or go sit at a desk.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Plus you can get up later .

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yes. That is a big advantage. However, it's more interesting to study with people in class.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Yeah, for some, I suppose. But not everyone.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: So do you prefer cats or dogs?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I prefer dogs. They're much more playful .

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: That may be true, but cats are cheaper . They don't eat as much as dogs.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: That is true. Dogs eat a lot, so they usually are more expensive . However, smaller dogs don't eat so much.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Also, cats are easier to take care of. Dogs are more demanding .

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Usually. Plus you don't have to walk cats.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I want a dog actually, but I need a bigger place if I get one.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: You would. Your place is too small.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: What do you usually do for dinner?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I usually cook at home. I never go out.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Really? I never cook. I always eat out.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: You should cook more. It's much healthier and cheaper

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Maybe, but eating out is more convenient and it's easier.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Not always. Plus, it is much more expensive to eat out all the time. Cooking is much cheaper .

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Not for me. When I buy groceries, I always end up wasting it. Plus cooking is more stressful . It is more relaxing to eat in a restaurant

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Maybe, but cooking is more enjoyable . I could never eat out every night.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: What is the fastest way to get to the airport?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: By taxi, but it’s the most expensive .

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: What’s the cheapest ?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: The local bus. But, it's by far t he slowest way to get there.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Hmm, I'd better spring for a taxi then.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Yeah, it’s best if you do.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: What is the best place to visit in your country?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I think the west coast. It has t he best weather.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: What about the cost?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: The costs are very high. Our most expensive cities are there.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Oh, that’s too bad. What about the food?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: It’s great. It has the best restaurants in the country.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: How was the movie last night?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Oh, it was great. It was the scariest movie I’ve ever seen.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Oh, really? That scary?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Yes, I was screaming throughout the film.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Was it crowded?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Yeah, it was the most packed I’ve ever seen the theater.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: What is the oldest city in your country?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I think it is the capital.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Is it the biggest ?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: It was, but not anymore.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Why are people moving out?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Well, it’s not the most modern place to live.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Where do you usually buy your groceries?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I usually go to City Market, because the prices are cheaper.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Yeah, it is cheaper there but the produce is not that fresh. So I stopped shopping there.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Oh, where do you shop?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I buy my groceries at Farmer’s Market, because the produce is much better.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yeah, but I hear it is much more expensive there.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: It is, but you get what you pay for.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I can’t argue with that!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: How do you like your new job?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: It’s great! The pay is much better, but my job is much more stressful.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: What about the benefits?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: They are about the same, but my vacation time is longer.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Oh, that’s nice. And how are your coworkers?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Everyone is nice, but the office environment is more serious. I miss my friends.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Sounds like you miss your old job. Any regrets?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: No, I am happier now. The money is worth it.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I heard you moved. Congratulations!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yes, I bought a house downtown.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Oh, great! How is the new place?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: It’s great. It is much bigger than my last place.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Nice. Is it a new house?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: No, it’s an older home, but it’s fairly new.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Does it have a yard?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: It does. It is a bit smaller than I’d like, but it is big enough for my dog.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Who is this in the picture?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: That is my younger sister.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Oh wow. She is so cute!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yes, she is. She looks much different now. That is five years ago.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Oh, how old is she now?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: She is 20. She is much taller now, and her hair is shorter.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Yeah, it’s amazing how much we change from our teens.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yep, we all get older, don’t we!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Where is Sue? She is not in class today.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: She may have a game. She is on the basketball team.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: No, that can’t be it, the season is over. Maybe she is sick.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: She might be sick. She looked tired yesterday.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: That might be it. I’ll call her and see if she’s OK.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: No, don’t do that. She might be sleeping.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: You’re right. I will wait for her to contact us.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Who knows? She might come today, she may just be late.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: When will you retire?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I might retire next year.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Really? So soon! What will you do after you retire?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I will probably travel. I love travelling.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: That sounds fun. Where will you go?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I ’ll probably go to Europe, but I may go to Asia.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Well, you will have lots of time. You can do both.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: You’re right. I might do both.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: What about hobbies? I know you like to play golf.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I probably won’t play golf that much. It’s too expensive.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: The mall is so crowded today. I cannot find parking.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I know! It’s full. There might be a sale at the department store.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Maybe, or there might be a special event.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Perhaps. What could it be?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: There might be a concert or festival.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: That could be it. I didn’t hear anything on the news, though.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Well, there might not be any parking for a while. Should we go home?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: No, let’s wait. A space might open up soon.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Look! Here comes someone. They might be leaving.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: They may be. Let’s see if they leave.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Where are the kids?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: No one is home yet. They may not come home for dinner.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: How come? Where is Jason?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I think he’s with his friends. They might be at the mall.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: What about Melanie?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: She’s not home yet. She might still be at school.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Well, I’m hungry. Let’s eat without them.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: No, let’s wait a little longer. They might be home soon.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: OK, but not too much longer.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: How is the weather in your area?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Not great. It snows a lot in winter, so it gets really cold. There is lots of ice on the streets, so it is hard to drive.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: What about the spring?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: The spring is not much better. It rains a lot, and it is really windy.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Well, what about summer and fall?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: The fall is really pretty, actually. The weather is cool, and the trees change colors, so it is really beautiful.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: How about summer?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Summer is not too bad, but it gets really hot, and we have lots of insects. It does not rain much though, so summer is great for being outside.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: What is the weather like in your area?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: It’s pretty good. It’s usually sunny, so you can be outdoors most of the year.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Do you have cold winters?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: No, it never gets that cold, and it never snows.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: What is your worst season?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Summer can be bad. We have thunderstorms, and it gets really hot.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I like thunderstorms. I think they are fun!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: They are sometimes, but sometimes it rains really hard, and we have lighting and flooding, so it’s a little dangerous.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: What about the spring and fall?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Both seasons are perfect! The spring is warm, and the fall is cool, and it never rains then.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Do you like your school?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Yes, the teachers are nice, and the campus is really pretty.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: How are your classes?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: They are a little difficult, but they are mostly interesting.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: What is your favorite class?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: My favorite class is my Spanish class because I love learning languages, and the teacher is really funny.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: What is your least favorite class?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: History. I do not like to read very much, and the class requires a lot of reading. Plus, the teacher is strict, and he gives a lot of homework.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yeah, that does not sound fun!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: How was the new Thai restaurant?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: It was good, but the prices were a little expensive.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: How was the food? What did you have?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I had the Thai soup. It was really good, but it was a little spicy.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Did you need a reservation?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: No, we went early, so the restaurant was not full.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: How was the service?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: It was really good. Our waiter was really nice. The service was excellent, so I gave him a big tip.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Why are you leaving early?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I ’m going to the dentist.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Why? Do you have a toothache?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: No, I ’m getting my teeth cleaned.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Well, if you are leaving early, I ’m leaving early too.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Fine with me!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: What are you doing tonight?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I ’m meeting my mom for dinner.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Oh! Where are you going ?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: We are going to the new Thai restaurant. Join us!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Thanks, but I can’t. I ’m playing futsal tonight.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Well, maybe next time.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: What classes are you taking next term?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I ’m taking math and history.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Nice, I ’m taking math too!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Who is teaching the class?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Professor Smith is teaching it.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Oh no, I hear he is hard!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: What is going on tonight?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Bill is having a party.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Oh, really? When and where?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: He ’s having it at his house. It i s starting at six.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Who is going ?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Everyone ’s going . You should come!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Do you want something to eat?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I want something , but not just anything .

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: What are you the mood for?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I’m in the mood for something spicy.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: What about spicy Thai soup?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: That sounds great. But you know what? Anything is fine.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Did you go anywhere this weekend?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Nowhere special, just the mall.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Did you buy anything ?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: No, I had no money.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Did you see anyone there?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: No, I didn’t see anyone .

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Where did you go yesterday?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Nowhere .

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Nowhere ! Come on. I’m sure you went somewhere .

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: No, really, I didn’t go anywhere . I stayed home.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I didn’t go anywhere either.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: My gosh. We are so boring!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Did anyone call?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: No. No one.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Nobody called?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: No. Were you expecting someone to call you?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Yes, someone .

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Ooh, who is this someone ?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Just someone . Nobody you know.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Are you coming to the meeting?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: When is it?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: It’s at one. It starts soon .

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Is the boss coming?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yes, he’s already there, I think.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: What about Sue?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I don’t know. She’s not here yet .

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: What about Jerry?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: He just called. He’s still out sick.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: He’s still sick! Lucky him!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Well, it’s almost time. We better go.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Right. I’ll be right there.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I’m back!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Welcome home!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Is dinner ready yet ?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Not yet, but it’s almost done.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Is the table set?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Yes, I already did it.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Are the kids back yet ?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: No, they’re still outside playing, but they should be back soon . I already texted them.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: So, what’s for dinner?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Lasagna. It’s still cooking, but it’s almost done.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Great! I’m starving!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Do you still work with Joe?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: No, not anymore . He just quit.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Oh no! Why?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: He just got a new job. He already started it, I think.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: What about Sue?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: She’s still there, but not for long. She just put in her notice.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: She is quitting too! Why?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: She just got engaged. She’s moving to London. Her fiancé lives there.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Well, your company is lucky they still have you!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: For now anyway?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Are you quitting, too?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Not yet , but soon ! I already started looking!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Hello, This is Maria. How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Ugh!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Hello, are you still there?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Yes, I am still here!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Thank you for waiting. Can I get your account number?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: What! I just gave it to the last person.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I’m sorry. Can you give it to me again ?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Why? I already gave it.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I know, but for security reasons, I need it again .

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: OK, but this is ridiculous.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I’m sorry sir. I promise that we’ll be finished soon .

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: OK, my number is …..

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Can you help me cook dinner?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Sure. How can I help?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Please make a fruit salad. Use the fruit on the table.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: OK. The bananas, strawberries, and kiwis?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yes, that’s right. Please cut them up and put them in a bowl. Wash them and then add yogurt on top. We will have it for dessert.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: SOK, I can do that. What else?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Then, set the table. Make places for five people. My friend will join us.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Oh, great! Anything else?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yes, after that, please text the kids. Tell them to be home by six.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Got it. I’m on it.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Where is the library?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: It’s not far from here. It’s in the park.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: How do you get there?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: It’s easy. Go down this road. At the second light, turn left.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: OK, so I walk down this road two blocks, and then turn left.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yes, that’s right. You will see the park. The library is in the park.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Thanks for your help.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Don’t mention it.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Mrs. Jones, I missed class. What is the homework?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Tonight, please write a 100 word essay about your hobby.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Can I write about football?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yes, of course. But, please write in pen, not pencil.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Can I use a computer and print it?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: No, do not use a computer. Write it by hand.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Can I write it in my notebook?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: No, use a piece of paper.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Is that all?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: No, also please read chapter 10 in your book.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Is that it?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yes, that’s it.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Lately, I feel sleepy and tired. I have low energy. Do you have any tips?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yes, eat lots of vegetables. Also, don’t eat carbs like bread, rice, and pasta.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: OK, what about meat?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Some meat is fine, but don’t eat fast food, like fried chicken.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: What about drinks?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Drink tea or water. Don’t drink beverages with sugar.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: What about exercise?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Exercise every day, but don’t exercise too much.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I can do that. Any other advise?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yes, get lots of sleep. Sleep 8 hours a day.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Oh, that’s easy. I love sleep.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Do you watch much TV?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Not anymore. I used to watch a lot of TV but not now. And you?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Yeah, I watch a lot of TV.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: What do you watch?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I watch a lot of dramas and some news shows.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I don’t watch the news much , but maybe I should.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Do you exercise much ?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Not that much but some.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: What do you do?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I go running a lot . What about you?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I don’t exercise at all .

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: That’s too bad. It can be fun!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Do you eat much fast food?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yeah, I eat it way too much!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Ooh, that’s not good. You should not eat it too much .

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I know, but I do it to save time. Plus, I don’t cook much .

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Me too, but I try to eat a lot of ruits and vegetables.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Good idea.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Do speak Spanish much ?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yeah, I speak it a lot at work.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: That must be nice.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: What about you?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Not that much . People do not use it much at my work.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: That’s too bad!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Do you have a pet?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I do. I have a dog, and I also have a cat.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Oh, really? I have a cat as well.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Really? What color?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: My cat is black.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: My cat is black, too !

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: What do you do?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I am a teacher.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Cool! I am a teacher, too .

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Really? What do you teach?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I teach math.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: No way! I also teach math.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: What shows do you like?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I like Game of Thrones.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I love that show, too .

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Who’s your favorite character?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I really like Jon Snow.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I like him, as well. .

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Where do you live?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I live downtown.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: So do I ! Where?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: By the station.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Me too ! I live on B Street.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Get out of here! I do, as well.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Hello. Can I get your name?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Yes. My name is Tom Wilson.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Great. And can I see your ID?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Sure. Here it is.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Thanks. And can you sign here?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Certainly.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Hello! Can I take your order?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yes, can I get the chicken sandwich?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Certainly. And can I get you something to drink?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yes, can I get a diet soda, please?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Sure. Anything else? Can I interest you in something on the side?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yes, can I get some fries with that?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Of course. Anything else?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: No, that will do.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: So Bob, can you come to the party?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Yes, I can , but can I get your address?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: It’s really long. Can I email it to you?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: That will work. Oh, and can I get your number?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: You know what, can you just put it in the email?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Sure. Can do.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Hello! Can I help you?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Yes, can I get a cafe mocha, please?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: OK. And can I get your name?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: It’s Jason. And can I get that without cream?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Of course. Anything else?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Yeah, can I get one of these muffins?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Sure. That comes to $5.45.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Great. Can I pay by debit card?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: You sure can .

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Awesome! And can I get a receipt?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Of course. Here’s your receipt.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: You can pick up your order over there.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: OK.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: What are you cooking? It smells great.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I am making chicken stew.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Oh, it looks so good.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Here, have a taste.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Oh my gosh! This tastes fantastic.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I am so glad you like it!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Wow! You look stunning.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Thanks. I have a date.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Ooh. Where are you going?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I’m going to the new Mexican restaurant.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: That sounds fun.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I’d invite you but…

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, I know. It’s a date. Have fun!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: What’s wrong? You look terrible.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I feel terrible. I have a cold.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Oh, sorry to hear that.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Any advice?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Well, I hear vinegar and lemon juice helps.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: That sounds awful. No thanks.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I like your sweater. Is it wool?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: No, it is cotton. Feel it?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Wow, it feels so soft.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: It is. It is so comfy too.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: It looks comfy. I want one.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Well, Christmas is almost here. Maybe someone special might get you one.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Ooh! That sounds promising.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Do you have a big apartment?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: No, it is very small. It has a kitchen, a living room and two bedrooms.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: How many bathrooms does it have?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: It has two bathrooms.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Do you have a balcony?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: No, but I have a view of the lake and the mountains.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: What is the apartment building like?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: It is nice. It has a pool, a laundry room and a gym.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Wow, sounds like a nice place!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: It’s alright. Not great, but not bad.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: What food do you have? I’m hungry.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: We have some fruit. We have some oranges, an apple and two bananas.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Yeah, I don’t want fruit. I’m not hungry for that.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Well, we have some chips, and some peanuts.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Yeah, I don’t want a snack, I want a meal. What else do we have?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: We have some leftovers. We have some pizza and some salad.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: That sounds perfect. Do you want some ?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: No, I’m not hungry. Thank you though.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Shopping for clothes online. I need some clothes for my ski trip.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: What do you need?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I need a ski jacket, some gloves and a scarf.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I have a scarf. Do you want it?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: No, thank you. I have an old scarf, but I want a new one.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: What about skis? I have some skis. Do you want to use them?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Yes, I do. Thank you for the offer.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: My pleasure! Please, come and get them any time.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Thank you, I appreciate that.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: What is your favorite place in town?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I like the park. It has many trees and flowers, and lots of grass.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I like the park, too. My favorite place is the mall.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: The mall? What do you like about it?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Well, it has some nice cafes and cheap stores for shopping.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: True. It also has some good restaurants.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: It does. It has a really good Korean restaurant.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Oh, I love that place! It’s really good.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Is your town a nice place to live?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yes, there are many nice places in my town.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Oh, yeah. What, for example?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Well, we have many nice parks and many nice restaurants.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: What about cafes? I like to study at cafes.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: We have a few cafes, but they are not great.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I am going to the supermarket. What do we need?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: We need some milk, some bread and some juice.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Do we need any eggs?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: No, we have a lot of eggs.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Do we need any butter?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yes, we have a little butter but we need more.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Do we have any apples?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: We have a few apples but we need some more, I think.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Is there a gym at your school?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yes, but it is not very good.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Oh, why is that?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Well, there isn’t much equipment.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Oh, that’s too bad. My school has a nice gym.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Does it have nice equipment?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Yes, it has lots of weight machines but not many free weights.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Sounds a lot better than my gym!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Do you want to go to the movies on Friday?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I can’t. I don’t have much money right now.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: That is OK. I can pay for you.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Oh, that’s sweet of you to offer. But, I don’t have much free time either.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Oh, are you busy?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yes, I have many assignments for school.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: OK, maybe next time.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Do you like cream with your coffee?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yes, but not too much .

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: What about sugar?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yes, I like my coffee sweet.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: How many sugar cubes?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Two should be enough .

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Do we have any lettuce?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Just a little but not much.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: How about tomatoes?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: We have a few . Why?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I want to make a salad.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Could do. We have lots of cucumber and a few onions.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Let’s make an omelet. How many eggs do we have?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: A dozen. We do not have much oil, though.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: It’s OK, we have some cooking spray. Do we have any cheese or ham?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: We have some cheese but not much. ham, I’m afraid.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: That’s OK, I can use tomatoes.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Great. We have too many and they will spoil soon.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: How much honey do we have?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Not much , but some .

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: How many bananas?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: We have a few , I think. Why?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I want to make a sandwich.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: With bananas and honey?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Do you have a bike I can borrow?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yeah, I have one , but it ’s very old.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Does it run well?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yeah, it works, but it might need a new tire.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: You know, I think I have one in the garage.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Perfect. Then, you are all set.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Would you like a cookie?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I would love one ! Did you make them yourself?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: No, I bought them at the store.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: They look delicious.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Oh, I hope you enjoy them .

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Do you have a pen I can use?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yes, you can use this one .

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Thanks, I'll give it right back.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: That’s OK. You can keep it .

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Oh, I just need it for a bit.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Really, keep it . I never use that one anyway.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Do you have any paper clips?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: There are some at my desk.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I’m sorry. I don’t see them .

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Oh, they are in the drawer.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: This one ? The top one ?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: No, the next one . That one !

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: OK, found them . Thanks.
